Airbus A350-900

The new long-haul aircraft from SWISS stands for more comfort on board and greater efficiency in flight operations. Look forward to a travel experience of the next generation.

Facts and figures

Since 2025, SWISS has been gradually expanding its fleet with a total of ten state-of-the-art Airbus A350-900 aircraft.

SWISS Wanderlust

SWISS is dedicating its first Airbus A350 to its home country with the special SWISS Wanderlust livery. The special illustrations, which were designed by a Swiss artist, show the diversity and beauty of Switzerland.

Behind the scenes

All new SWISS Airbus A350-900s are built in Toulouse in one of the most modern factories in aviation. This is where the final assembly takes place, with the highest precision and state-of-the-art technology.
